product.description: Monoprice™Commercial Series Heavy-Duty Free-Standing Large Screen Floor Mount for Portrait Displays, Fits 43"–90" TVsThe Monoprice Commercial Series Heavy-Duty Free-Standing Large Screen Floor Mount for Portrait Displays provides a stable, professional solution for large portrait-oriented displays in indoor commercial environments where wall mounting is not practical.
